name: SikaFX Payment API
description:
The SikaFX Payment API provides a unified interface for sending payments across Africa.
Integrate once to access bank transfers and mobile money payouts in multiple countries.

## Authentication

All requests require a Bearer token using your API key:

```
Authorization: Bearer sk_test_abc123...
```

| Environment | Key prefix | Base URL |
|-------------|-----------|----------|
| Sandbox | `sk_test_` | `https://sandbox.sikafx.com` |
| Production | `sk_live_` | `https://api.sikafx.com` |

## Conventions

- All request and response bodies use **snake_case** field names.
- Monetary amounts are strings with up to 4 decimal places (e.g. `"1500.0000"`).
- Timestamps are ISO 8601 in UTC (e.g. `"2026-01-15T09:30:00Z"`).
- Paginated endpoints return a standard envelope with `data` and `pagination` fields.
